The '''SWE/2 Riot Suppression Gun''', colloqiually known as a '''Popper''', was a breach-loading, dual barrel [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]]. It was primarily used by [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agencies]] for crowd control purposes. Each barrel held one ammunition shell, and could be fired independently or at the same time. Each shell emitted an expanding wall of over-pressurized air and chemical reactants that could knock down doors, peoples, and barricades.

[[Swoop gang/Legends|Swoop gang]] member [[Roy Harlison]] carried an SWE/2 named "[[Old Besi]]" to help defend [[Rabid Mynocks]] turf in [[Gallisport]] on [[Shesharile 5]].
